verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented input or output guardrail mechanism for validating, transforming, or blocking unsafe content. The closest items are structured-output schema enforcement (output_type) and deferred tools that need user approval. These are adjacent features (format validation and human-in-the-loop tool approval), not content-safety guardrails on inputs and outputs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach input/output guardrails that validate, transform, or block unsafe content
